card.name: Sentence-ending punctuation before a new sentence
card.fires_on: A closing parenthesis after a news dateline, or a period ending a sentence, where a new sentence or article body begins next. Mostly in HealthDay or ScienceDaily bylines and regulatory text.

modes.label: News dateline close
modes.description: Closing parenthesis after a news source and date, right before the article text starts.
